title: Personal notes with a choice of storage
description: The place of storage, access to the entries, restoring them and exporting the archive are all clear in advance.

blocks.text: The owner of personal entries may not want to hand their contents over to a service. The review shows that expectation, but does not confirm how well protected the app mentioned actually is.

quote.text: I freaking love this app, Notesnook does not know what I write and what I do on their app (I am doing nothing illegal 😂) and that’s just perfect that I know my data won’t be sold to 3rd party companies or reviewed by Notesnook themselves.

blocks.text: Choose a model of storage and access and explain it clearly. If encryption is offered, its implementation, the way the copies work and the restore have to be tested separately.

A local file, cloud sync and protection from being read are different properties. They can’t all be promised with one padlock icon. The terms have to stay clear when a device is lost, a password is changed and a subscription ends.
